# opendraft

> opendraft is a React + Tailwind CSS v4 design system distributed as a shadcn registry and built to be used by AI assistants. Components install as source files into your project with the shadcn CLI, behavior comes from Radix, and every color, radius and timing comes from a small set of theme tokens.

## How to build with opendraft

You are building a React interface with the opendraft design system. Follow these rules. They matter more than your own taste, but the person you're building for comes first: when they ask for their own fonts, colors or corner radius, apply them through the brand tokens in section 4.

### 1. Set up the project once

opendraft ships through a shadcn registry. Components install as source files into the project. There is no npm package to import.

Requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, and a shadcn `components.json`. Next.js is supported but not required.

If you can't run shell commands (a chat assistant, or a hosted builder), install by hand: for each item, fetch `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/r/<name>.json`. Its `files[].content` is the source and `files[].path` is where to write it in the project. Then repeat for every name in its `registryDependencies`, and for theirs in turn (it is transitive). Strip the `@opendraft/` prefix; a bare name such as `utils` is an opendraft item too. Add every package in each item's `dependencies` with the project's package manager. The `theme` item has no files: it only has a `css` field, which you paste into the global stylesheet (do this first). Skip any file you've already written.

Not on Next.js (Vite, Lovable, Remix, Astro): everything works the same except fonts and the `"use client"` lines. Load the three fonts with a Google Fonts `<link>` or `@fontsource` packages and set `--font-geist`, `--font-geist-mono` and `--font-newsreader` on `:root` to the family names. Ignore `"use client"`; it's harmless. Use `import "./index.css"` (or your global stylesheet) where steps below say `app/globals.css`, and add the `dark` class to `<html>` yourself.

1. If the project has no `components.json`, run `npx shadcn@latest init`. That command fetches from ui.shadcn.com. If it fails (a blocked network), write the file by hand:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "new-york",
  "rsc": true,
  "tsx": true,
  "tailwind": {
    "config": "",
    "css": "app/globals.css",
    "baseColor": "neutral",
    "cssVariables": true
  },
  "iconLibrary": "lucide",
  "aliases": {
    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib/utils",
    "ui": "@/components/ui",
    "lib": "@/lib",
    "hooks": "@/hooks"
  }
}
```

2. Add the registry to `components.json`:

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@opendraft": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

3. Install the theme first. It writes the tokens into the global stylesheet:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/theme
```

4. Clean up the starter stylesheet. Projects made with `create-next-app` leave rules in `app/globals.css` that fight the theme, and after the theme is added they can sit in the middle of the file, so search the whole file. Delete them:
   - the `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { … } }` block (dark mode here is the `dark` class, not the operating system setting)
   - the starter's `body { background: …; color: …; font-family: Arial, … }` rule (the theme sets the body styles)
   - the starter's own `:root { --background; --foreground }` values, if they remain after the theme's (the theme's must win)
   - the starter's `@theme inline { … }` block that maps `--font-sans` / `--font-mono` to `--font-geist-sans` / `--font-geist-mono` (the theme maps the fonts itself)
5. Install each component you use, by name:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/button @opendraft/card @opendraft/prompt-bar
```

6. Load three fonts and expose them as CSS variables: Geist as `--font-geist`, Geist Mono as `--font-geist-mono`, Newsreader as `--font-newsreader`. In Next.js use `next/font/google` (the starter's `--font-geist-sans` is not the same variable; rename it).
7. Dark mode is the `dark` class on `<html>`. The `theme-toggle` component (`npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/theme-toggle`) handles it: it switches system, light and dark and remembers the choice. To avoid a flash of the wrong theme on load, also run its exported `themeScript` before the page paints, and add `suppressHydrationWarning` to `<html>` because the script changes its class:

```tsx
import { themeScript } from "@/components/ui/theme-toggle"

// app/layout.tsx
;<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
  <head>
    <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript }} />
  </head>
  <body>{children}</body>
</html>
```

Without opendraft's toggle you can use `next-themes` with `attribute="class"` instead. 8. Wrap the app once so motion respects the user's "reduce motion" setting, and mount the toaster. A layout is a server component, so do this in a small client file (for example `components/providers.tsx` with `"use client"`) and wrap `{children}` with it in `app/layout.tsx`:

```tsx
import { MotionConfig } from "motion/react"

import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/sonner"

;<MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">
  {children}
  <Toaster />
</MotionConfig>
```

On Next.js 16 with Cache Components (the new `create-next-app` default), a component that reads `usePathname()`, `useSearchParams()`, `params` or `searchParams` must sit inside a `<Suspense>` boundary, or the build fails. Also, a server component can't pass a function (including an icon component such as a lucide icon) to a client component as a prop: pass the element (`<Icon />`) or an icon name instead.

### 2. Use components before writing your own

- If the product is for a specific industry or job (security, IT and infrastructure, aviation, logistics, and so on), read the matching playbook in the Use cases list first, before choosing components. It names the components that serve each need, rates how well they fit, lists the typical screens, and gives one install command for a starter kit. Follow its domain principles (for example how to show severity, status and time). If no playbook matches, pick by need from the component list and apply the same care.
- If the user asks for a whole screen (a dashboard, settings page, sign-in, CRM board, agent chat), check the Blocks list first. A block is a complete, working screen. Install it, then change the content through its props (it renders sample data when given none). Restyle it with tokens, not by rewriting it, and trim sections the user didn't ask for. Blocks fill the space they're given and lay out from their own width, so put one in a container that has a width and a height (for example a `w-full` parent with `h-screen` or a fixed height); in a shrink-to-fit parent it collapses. Give every page the same width with `PageContainer`, and head it with `PageHeader`. Build forms with `Field`, with `FieldGroup` for rows, and use `DatePicker` for single dates and `RepeaterField` for add-and-remove rows.
- Check the component list below before building any UI. If a component fits, install and use it, even if you'd only use part of it.
- Import from where the CLI installs them: `@/components/ui/*` for core pieces, `@/components/motion/*` for motion pieces, `@/components/agents/*` for AI and data pieces.
- Compose screens from components. Don't copy a component's internals into a page.
- Many components render sample content when you give them no data (their pages say "sample content") (ice-cream shop names, example transactions, demo prompts). Always pass the real content through their props: rows, items, labels, options, callbacks. Check the component's page for its props. Leaving the defaults in a real screen is a bug.
- Some components have a `fill` or `demo` prop. `demo` runs a self-playing walkthrough, so set `demo={false}` in a real screen. `fill` makes a scrolling area take its container's height instead of a fixed maximum, so give the container a height.
- Know the limits before you pick one. `SearchList` takes plain strings only and isn't a way to filter a grid of rich cards: use `Input` and filter your own data. `Table` needs a fixed pixel `rowHeight`; give it `height` for a scrolling area or `maxHeight` to size to its rows. `CardTitle` and `DialogTitle` are already styled: don't add `heading` to them.
- Only write a new component when nothing fits. Build it from the existing parts and follow the rules below.

### 3. Style only with tokens

Never hard-code colors, shadows, radii, easings or spring values. Use these Tailwind classes, which read the theme tokens:

| Purpose                                         | Use                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Page background / text                          | `bg-background`, `text-foreground`                                                                  |
| Cards and panels                                | `bg-card`, `border` (a hairline)                                                                    |
| Quiet areas, inputs, wells                      | `bg-muted`, `bg-surface`                                                                            |
| Secondary text                                  | `text-muted-foreground`                                                                             |
| Hover background                                | `bg-accent`                                                                                         |
| Primary action                                  | `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` (blue by default)                                              |
| Accent text, links, focus strokes               | `text-brand`, `border-brand`                                                                        |
| Solid black buttons and bands                   | `bg-ink text-ink-foreground` (inverts in dark mode)                                                 |
| Status                                          | `text-success`, `text-warning`, `text-destructive` (tints: `bg-success/10`, etc.)                   |
| Lines                                           | `border-border`, `border-input`                                                                     |
| Floating layers only (menus, popovers, dialogs) | `bg-popover shadow-md`                                                                              |
| Extra blues for charts and textures             | `bg-blue-50` … `bg-blue-950`                                                                        |
| Headings and big numbers (stats, prices)        | `heading` (the heading font at its weight and tracking)                                             |
| Corners                                         | `rounded-md` / `rounded-control` for controls, `rounded-lg` / `rounded-surface` for cards and menus |

Text over a texture (`PixelField`, `bg-dots`): don't put it straight on the texture and don't add a gradient scrim. Put the text in a `dark` section, or on a solid `bg-background` panel, so it stays readable. Fonts: `font-sans` is the body font, `font-display` (or the `heading` utility) the heading font, `font-mono` the code font; use `font-mono` for money, dates and IDs.

Don't use Tailwind's palette colors (`bg-gray-100`, `text-emerald-600`, …) and don't add `dark:` color twins. The tokens already switch between light and dark.

### 4. The look, and making it yours

opendraft ships with a look: editorial headings, square corners, hairline borders, a blue primary. Treat it as the default. If the person asks for something different, their request wins, and you apply it by changing the brand tokens at the top of `:root` in the global stylesheet. Never restyle individual components to get a new look; change the token and every component follows.

| They ask for                                                  | Change                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| A heading font (any Google Font, e.g. Inter)                  | `--font-heading`, plus `--heading-weight` (about 300 for light serifs like the default Newsreader, 500 to 600 for sans faces like Inter) and `--heading-tracking`                                                                                |
| A body / interface font (any Google Font, e.g. IBM Plex Sans) | `--font-body`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| A code font                                                   | `--font-code`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| A primary color (e.g. black)                                  | `--primary` and `--brand` in `:root` and in `.dark`. Set `--primary-foreground` to a color that reads on it (white on dark colors, near-black on light ones). For black, use `var(--ink)` and `var(--ink-foreground)`: they invert in dark mode. |
| Rounder buttons and inputs (e.g. 12px)                        | `--control-radius`                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rounder cards, menus and dialogs                              | `--surface-radius` (usually the same as or a little larger than `--control-radius`)                                                                                                                                                              |
| Larger or smaller text                                        | `--text-scale` (1 is the default; 1.1 makes every text size 10% larger, 0.9 10% smaller). Spacing stays the same.                                                                                                                                |

Any of the roughly 1,900 Google Fonts works. Load it with `next/font/google` (the export name replaces spaces with underscores, e.g. `IBM_Plex_Sans`; pass `variable: "--font-ibm-plex-sans"`, and `weight` for fonts that aren't variable), or with a `<link>` from fonts.google.com outside Next.js. Point the token at the variable, falling back to the family name and a generic stack so it works either way:

```css
:root {
  --font-heading:
    var(--font-inter, "Inter"), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body:
    var(--font-ibm-plex-sans, "IBM Plex Sans"), ui-sans-serif, system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  --heading-weight: 600;
  --heading-tracking: -0.03em;
  --primary: var(--ink);
  --brand: var(--ink);
  --primary-foreground: var(--ink-foreground);
  --control-radius: 12px;
  --surface-radius: 16px;
  --text-scale: 1.1;
}
```

The defaults, for anything they haven't asked to change:

- **Corners.** Controls use `rounded-md`, cards and menus `rounded-lg`; both follow the radius tokens. Use `rounded-full` only for avatars, status dots and spinners.
- **Hairlines over shadows.** Structure comes from 1px borders. Shadows are only for things that float above the page.
- **One primary color.** Use it for the main action and focus. Keep everything else neutral.
- **Type.** Headings use the `heading` utility. Interface text uses the default sans (`font-sans`, which is `--font-body`). Labels, counts and metadata use `font-mono`; small uppercase section labels use the `eyebrow` utility.
- **Texture.** Use `bg-dots` or the `PixelField` component for background texture. Don't use gradients or blobs.
- **Dark sections.** Add the `dark` class to any section to render it dark in either theme.

### 5. Motion

- Import timings from `@/lib/motion` (installed with any animated component): `spring.snappy` for presses and toggles, `spring.smooth` for panels and layout, `spring.pop` for arrivals, `ease.out` with `duration.base` for fades.
- For menus, popovers and tooltips use the CSS utilities `animate-pop-in` and `animate-pop-out`. For entrances use `animate-fade-up` and stagger with `animation-delay`.
- Use Motion (`motion/react`) for state changes: layout, enter and exit, springs.
- Animate `transform` and `opacity`, not layout properties, and keep motion short.

### 6. Accessibility

Components use Radix primitives and come with keyboard and screen-reader support. Keep it: give icon-only buttons an `aria-label`, keep visible focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-ring`), and don't remove roles or labels when you customise a component.

### 7. Before you finish

- Every color, radius, shadow and timing comes from a token, and any look the person asked for lives in the brand tokens, not in component overrides.
- Every piece of UI that exists in opendraft uses the opendraft component.
- The screen works in both light and dark mode.
- Headings use the `heading` utility; nothing else does.

## Use cases

### Pick by what the product does

If the product is for a specific industry or job, read its playbook before choosing components. A playbook lists the domain's usual needs, the opendraft components that serve each (with a fit rating), the screens to assemble, and one install command for a starter kit. Match the request against each playbook's signals; if none matches, pick by need from the component list below.

- [Security and compliance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/security.md): Security operations, threat detection, access control and audit products. Used by analysts under pressure: dense data, fast triage, irreversible actions. Signals: security, soc, siem, threat, incident response, vulnerability, edr, iam. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-security`
- [IT, DevOps and infrastructure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/it-infrastructure.md): Monitoring, incident management, deployments, logs and internal tools for engineers and IT teams. Signals: devops, sre, infrastructure, monitoring, observability, uptime, status page, deployment. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-it-infrastructure`
- [Aviation and travel operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/aviation.md): Airline and airport operations, flight information, booking and check-in, crew and maintenance tools. Safety-critical context: clarity and correctness beat flourish. Signals: aviation, airline, airport, flight, aircraft, pilot, crew, boarding. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-aviation`
- [Logistics, supply chain and fleet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/logistics.md): Shipment tracking, dispatch, warehouse and fleet products for operators, drivers and customers who need to know where things are and when they'll arrive. Signals: logistics, shipping, shipment, freight, carrier, courier, delivery, last mile. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-logistics`
- [Healthcare and patient care](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/healthcare.md): Clinical and patient-facing health products: EHR views, scheduling, telehealth and patient portals. Clinicians work under time pressure with safety-critical data; patients need calm, plain-language screens. Signals: healthcare, health, clinical, ehr, emr, patient, patient portal, telehealth. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-healthcare`
- [Fintech and banking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/fintech.md): Banking, payments, trading, personal finance and lending products. Money moves, so precision, clear fees and honest balances matter more than delight; many actions cannot be undone. Signals: fintech, banking, bank, payments, payment, transfer, card, neobank. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-fintech`
- [E-commerce and marketplaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/ecommerce.md): Storefronts, marketplaces and seller dashboards. Shoppers need honest prices and stock and a fast path to pay; sellers need to manage orders and inventory in bulk. Signals: ecommerce, e-commerce, store, storefront, shop, marketplace, cart, checkout. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-ecommerce`
- [Education and learning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/education.md): Learning platforms, courses, classrooms and student information systems. Learners need to know where they are and what is next; instructors need to see a whole class at a glance and act in bulk. Signals: education, learning, lms, course, courses, classroom, student, teacher. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-education`
- [Energy, utilities and EV charging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/energy-utilities.md): Grid operations, smart metering, solar and storage, EV charging networks, field service and customer billing for electricity, gas and water providers. Numbers carry units, time carries a zone, and some actions can hurt people or equipment. Signals: energy, utility, utilities, grid, smart meter, metering, scada, outage. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-energy-utilities`
- [Government and civic services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/government-civic.md): Public-sector portals for permits, licences, benefits, tax, records requests, case management and civic engagement. Used by everyone, including people in stress, on old phones and with assistive technology, so clarity and access come before polish. Signals: government, public sector, civic, citizen, permit, licence, benefits, welfare. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-government-civic`
- [Manufacturing and industrial operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/manufacturing.md): Manufacturing execution (MES), shop-floor terminals, quality control, maintenance and industrial IoT dashboards. Used by operators on a feet-and-gloves schedule and by engineers and managers reviewing lines, lots and downtime. Signals: manufacturing, mes, shop floor, factory, production line, oee, downtime, quality control. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-manufacturing`
- [HR and people operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/use-cases/hr-people.md): HRIS, recruiting, onboarding, payroll, performance and time-off products used by employees, managers and HR teams. The data is personal and sensitive, so who can see what, and who changed what, is part of the design. Signals: human resources, hris, people ops, recruiting, applicant, candidate, onboarding, offboarding. Kit: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kit-hr-people`

Machine-readable index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/use-cases.json

## Components

### Blocks

- [CRM Pipeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/crm-pipeline.md): Sales pipeline with a stage board, sortable list view, search, drag or menu moves, and a deal detail panel with an activity timeline. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/crm-pipeline`
- [Analytics Dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/analytics-dashboard.md): Analytics screen with range tabs, KPI cards, a metric chart, a sortable top-pages table and a channel breakdown. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/analytics-dashboard`
- [Settings Page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/settings-page.md): Settings with profile, notifications, team and billing sections, an unsaved-changes bar and a type-to-confirm danger zone. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/settings-page`
- [Auth Screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/auth-screen.md): Split sign-in and sign-up screen with validation, social providers, loading and error states, and a brand panel. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/auth-screen`
- [Agent Workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/agent-workspace.md): AI agent chat workspace: conversation rail, thread with thinking, tool calls and streamed answers, prompt bar and a live task panel. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/agent-workspace`
- [Checkout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/checkout.md): Three-step checkout (details, payment, confirmation) with validation, a sticky order summary with quantity steppers and discount codes, and ticket-pass confirmation. Card details stay in the form; only the last four digits reach your code. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/checkout`
- [Catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/catalog.md): Browse and discovery screen: featured band, search, category chips, sort, price filter, availability switch, card grid, active filters, empty state and loading skeleton. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/catalog`
- [Detail Page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/detail-page.md): Detail page with a sticky purchase panel: media, meta, key facts, tabs, tier selection with quantity, running total, checkout and waitlist. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/detail-page`
- [Order Confirmation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/order-confirmation.md): Order confirmed screen with a completed stepper, order number, stat row, one ticket pass per ticket, an order summary and download, calendar, view-tickets and continue actions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/order-confirmation`

### AI Agents

- [Voice Orb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/voice-orb.md): Breathing WebGL liquid orb that reacts to a voice level or an audio analyser. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/voice-orb`
- [Message Bubble](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/message-bubble.md): Chat bubble surfaces with variants, a pop-in entrance and a collapsible body. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/message-bubble`
- [Message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/message.md): Message rows with avatar, header, footer, markers and a typing indicator. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/message`
- [Message Scroller](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/message-scroller.md): Transcript that follows streamed output, with a rail for jumping between turns. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/message-scroller`
- [Prompt Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/prompt-input.md): Auto-growing prompt box with a model picker, an action menu and send / stop. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/prompt-input`
- [Streaming Response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/streaming-response.md): Streamed answer with copy, retry, feedback and a sources footer. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/streaming-response`
- [Citations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/citations.md): Inline citation markers, favicon stacks and a collapsible source list. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/citations`
- [Agent Activity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/agent-activity.md): Collapsible run log of steps, web searches and tool calls. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/agent-activity`
- [Agent Loading States](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/loading-states.md): Thinking shimmer, elapsed-time progress and rotating reasoning text. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/loading-states`
- [Todo List](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/todo-list.md): Live task plan with per-item progress and a rolling completed count. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/todo-list`
- [Tool Result](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/tool-result.md): Tool call card for terminal, request and file output with status, copy and retry. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tool-result`
- [Code Block](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/code-block.md): Streaming code with Shiki highlighting, line highlights and copy. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/code-block`
- [File Diff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/file-diff.md): Streaming unified diff with added and removed counts. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/file-diff`
- [Approval Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/approval-card.md): Human-in-the-loop card: stepped questions, or approve / request changes / reject. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/approval-card`
- [Tool Approval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/tool-approval.md): Permission prompt for a tool call: parameters, allow once or always, deny. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tool-approval`
- [Image Generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/image-generation.md): Image frame with queued, generating, refining and complete states. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/image-generation`
- [AI Sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/ai-sidebar.md): Resource tree for agent workspaces: select, expand, drag to move and rename. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/ai-sidebar`
- [Chat App](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/chat-app.md): Chat shell with a conversation sidebar that folds away when space runs out. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/chat-app`
- [Question Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/question-card.md): One question at a time in a sliding stack with an odometer step counter and auto-advance on single choice. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/question-card`
- [Chat Panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/chat-panel.md): Chat panel with context tabs, a scripted reply sequence that starts on send, and a composer. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/chat-panel`
- [Recommendation Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/recommendation-card.md): Recommendation with a confidence meter, an alternatives drawer that swaps the pick, and a confirm action. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/recommendation-card`
- [Context Cards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/context-cards.md): Retrieved context chunks that stagger in, then reveal their source file chips. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/context-cards`
- [Prompt Bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/prompt-bar.md): A composer with @ sources, / commands, a model picker, dictation and attachments, plus a self-running demo. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/prompt-bar`
- [Selection Actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/selection-actions.md): A contextual AI bar under selected text that animates its width between modes and streams in a rewrite. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/selection-actions`
- [Pixel Loader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/pixel-loader.md): A 3×3 pixel-grid loader with a shimmering status label and a live elapsed timer, in four motion variants. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/pixel-loader`
- [Thinking Trace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/thinking-trace.md): An expandable agent trace that shimmers while working, then settles. Steps, reasoning, search and coding variants. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/thinking-trace`
- [Streaming Answer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/streaming-answer.md): An answer that streams in word by word with an inline citation, then shows actions, sources and follow-ups. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/streaming-answer`
- [Task Rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/task-rows.md): Task rows with progress rings, status pills and expandable details, run through a failed, retry, done sequence. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/task-rows`
- [Tool Chips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/tool-chips.md): An agent run as compact tool-call rows with inline chips, then file-diff chips that preview their diff on hover. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tool-chips`
- [Agent Screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/agent-screen.md): Live agent-screen card that expands to a full-screen viewer with Teach-a-task recording. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/agent-screen`
- [Code Panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/code-panel.md): Light editor panel with a line-numbered Code view and a unified Diff view with word-level highlights. Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/code-panel`

### Components

- [Accordion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/accordion.md): Stacked sections that expand with a spring-driven height animation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/accordion`
- [Sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/animated-sidebar.md): Docked, icon rail or off-canvas sidebar with a mobile sheet, menus and sub-menus. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/animated-sidebar`
- [Avatar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/avatar.md): Image or initials, alone or overlapped in a group. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/avatar`
- [Badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/badge.md): Small square status label, with an optional dot. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/badge`
- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/button.md): Primary, ink, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link, with a loading state. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/button`
- [Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/card.md): Bordered surface with header, action, content and footer slots. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/card`
- [Checkbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/checkbox.md): Checkbox with a drawn check and an indeterminate state. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/checkbox`
- [Command Palette](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/command-palette.md): ⌘K palette with fuzzy search, groups, hints and keyboard navigation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/command-palette`
- [Data Table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/table.md): Virtualized table: sort, resize and reorder columns, select rows, edit cells. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/table`
- [Date Range Picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/date-range-picker.md): Range calendar in a popover, with month and year choosers and min / max. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/date-range-picker`
- [Dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/dialog.md): Modal dialog that springs in, with header, body and footer slots. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/dialog`
- [Drawer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/drawer.md): Side sheet with a backdrop that closes on Esc or an outside click. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/drawer`

Shows sample content (an ice cream shop) until you pass your own data through its props. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/sidebar-nav`
- [Quantity Stepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/quantity-stepper.md): Minus, value and plus control with min, max and step, controlled or uncontrolled, with optional press-and-hold repeat. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/quantity-stepper`
- [Progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/progress.md): Horizontal progress bar with a label row and a tone that follows how full or empty it is, for quotas and stock. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/progress`
- [Stat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/stat.md): KPI tile with a label, a large value, a change chip and an optional toggle-button mode, plus a grouped grid. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/stat`
- [Empty State](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/empty-state.md): Centered empty block with an optional icon, title, description and action slots, for tables, lists and cards. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/empty-state`
- [Stepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/stepper.md): Numbered step indicator for multi-step flows like checkout, horizontal or vertical, that never overflows on mobile. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/stepper`
- [Theme Toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/theme-toggle.md): Icon menu that switches between system, light and dark by toggling the dark class, and remembers the choice. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/theme-toggle`
- [Site Header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/site-header.md): Sticky top bar with a brand slot, nav links, an actions slot and a mobile menu. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/site-header`
- [QR Code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/qr-code.md): A real, scannable QR code drawn as an inline SVG, readable in light and dark themes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/qr-code`
- [Ticket Pass](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/ticket-pass.md): Digital ticket card with a title band, details grid, tear line, QR stub and a status badge. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/ticket-pass`
- [Page Header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/page-header.md): Page title block with eyebrow, description, actions and breadcrumb slots, plus a container that gives every route the same width and gutters. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/page-header`
- [Field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/field.md): Form field wrapper that pairs a label, control, hint and error message and wires ids and ARIA attributes, with a responsive group and fieldset. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/field`
- [Date Picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/date-picker.md): Single-date picker in a popover with an accessible month grid and an optional HH:MM time field (12h or 24h), using ISO string values. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/date-picker`
- [Repeater Field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/repeater-field.md): Add and remove rows editor for repeatable groups, with min/max, optional move up/down, live announcements and animated rows. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/repeater-field`
- [Timeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/timeline.md): Vertical event timeline with status markers that never rely on color alone, mono timestamps, a side time column on wide containers, expandable detail, collapsible long lists, and loading and empty states. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/timeline`
- [Alert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/alert.md): Callout with a per-variant icon, optional dismiss, an actions slot and a full-bleed banner mode for system, weather and policy notices. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/alert`
- [Status Indicator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/status-indicator.md): Shape plus word status (operational, degraded, down, maintenance) and an uptime bar of segments with an accessible summary. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/status-indicator`
- [Slider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/slider.md): Single or range slider on Radix with a label row, formatted value and marks. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/slider`
- [Dropzone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/dropzone.md): Drag-and-drop or click-to-browse file area with size, type and count validation, camera capture and a file list with progress. No upload logic. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/dropzone`
- [OTP Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/otp-input.md): One-time-code entry on a single real input, with paste, a separator and complete, invalid and disabled states. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/otp-input`

- [Blur Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/blur-text.md): Text that arrives word by word or character by character. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/blur-text`
- [Copy Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/copy-button.md): Copies a value and morphs its icon into a check. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/copy-button`
- [Loader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/loader.md): Fifteen loading animations, from spinners to ASCII and metaballs. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/loader`
- [Magnetic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/magnetic.md): Pulls its child gently toward the cursor. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/magnetic`
- [Marquee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/marquee.md): Seamless scrolling row with faded edges. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/marquee`
- [Pixel Field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/pixel-field.md): Canvas pixel textures in the blue scale: mosaic, dot matrix and equalizer. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/pixel-field`
- [Preview Rail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/preview-rail.md): Tick rail with hover previews for jumping between sections. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/preview-rail`
- [Reveal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/reveal.md): Fades and lifts content into view as it scrolls in. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/reveal`
- [Shimmer Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/shimmer-text.md): A light sweep across text, for thinking and loading labels. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/shimmer-text`
- [Spotlight Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/spotlight-card.md): Card whose border and surface light up under the cursor. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/spotlight-card`
- [Text Scramble](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms/text-scramble.md): Characters scramble, then resolve to the new text. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/text-scramble`

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://ui-system-virid.vercel.app/docs/introduction): What opendraft is and how it's put together.
- [Use with AI](https://ui-system-virid.vercel.app/docs/ai): Give an AI assistant one link so it builds with opendraft's components and tokens.
- [Use cases](https://ui-system-virid.vercel.app/docs/use-cases): Playbooks that tell you, and your AI assistant, which components suit security, IT, aviation and logistics products.
- [Installation](https://ui-system-virid.vercel.app/docs/installation): Add the registry to a project and install components.
- [Theming](https://ui-system-virid.vercel.app/docs/theming): Color, type, shape and texture tokens, in both themes.
- [Motion](https://ui-system-virid.vercel.app/docs/motion): The shared springs, easings and durations in lib/motion.ts.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/llms-full.txt): these rules plus every component page (props, types, examples) in one file
- [Registry index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuelmdesign/UI-System/HEAD/public/r/registry.json): every installable registry item as JSON
